text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Oh... *che elegante!* 
Are these outfits not just like kitchen 
*maestre*!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
The studio decorations are super cute too! 
Ooooh... my exciting Big Bang won't stop, 
*masen*!

text_block_list.name: Student Organizer
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, well then—let's begin recording 
episode 1 right away. 
Did you memorize the script?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry! 
I've got pretty much everything in my 
brain, *mashita*!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Please enjoy our *duo* to your heart's 
content. 
Now then—*ci siamo!*

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Howdy! "Taiki & Earth's: Reach Out! My 
Heart!" 
We'll be broadcasting starting today, 
*ma~su*!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Our memorable first episode! First up is 
how to use confectionery tools! 
We'll be demonstrating it live, *yo*~!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Whether baking sweets or playing music, 
befriending your instruments is paramount. 
Now, listen closely to the *melodia* our 
tools play...!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Hi! It's cooking time!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
First up is the whisk! Not only does it 
mix-mix chocolate and cream, but with 
enough speed and power, it's a super tool 
that can even cut things, *desu*!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oops, while smashing it to smithereens, 
let's boil some water in a pot! 
The temperature is—100 degrees? 1000 
degrees? Roughly—

text_block_list.name: Student Organizer
text_block_list.text: W-W-Wait, stop!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: ? Why?

text_block_list.name: Student Organizer
text_block_list.text:
The measurements are way too approximate, 
or rather... 
No, before that, you have to follow the 
script...!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, sorry! I accidentally ad-libbed, 
*mashita*! 
But no problem! Because—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
It all ends up the same once you eat it, 
*de~su*!!

text_block_list.name: Student Organizer
text_block_list.text:
No, that totally ruins the show's concept, 
doesn't it!? 
And Earth-san, why are you just playing 
music over there!?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Fufu—that is what one calls *destino*. 
Because—yes, ...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: I simply♪ cannot cook♪ anything at all~♪

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Cut the chocolate! Cut! Sometimes crush! 
It feels pretty good smashing it, *desu*! 
Whew!"

text_block_list.name: Stirred Viewers
text_block_list.text:
"Wh... what on earth is this show..." "Is 
this supposed to be a baking show...?" 
"Is it a comedy sketch?" "Might be a death 
metal concert..."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...I was worried, but... 
...I don't even know where to begin 
commenting.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... This is practically a combat sport 
under the guise of baking sweets...! 
Is even delicious Mr. Chocolate destined 
for nothing but utter devastation~!?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Doryaaaah! 
Let's melt it on high heat like it's our 
sworn enemy, *ma~su*!"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...They're grilling chocolate on a wire 
mesh again...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Doryaryaryaryaryaaaa~!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
...Huh!? Wait, that voice... 
That's not coming from the video, is it?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Mmmrgh... Oh, NO! 
The chopped chocolate went flying 
again-da-gaa!?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, let us not become so <italics>irritato</italics>. 
La la la~ 
O beauteous lady in brown~♪ Show us your 
smooth, silky grace~♪

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Wh-What are you two doing?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, it's homework from the show's 
staff-desu! They told us to do special 
training for making sweets before the 
second episode-deshita!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
But... doing things delicately is so 
hard-desu! My passion to do everything 
with a BAM gets in the way!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. Indeed, I cannot deny feeling a touch 
of <italics>confusione</italics>—yet the light of improvement 
shines bright.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Behold! Inspired by conducting an <italics> 
orchestra</italics>—look at the graceful swirling of 
this spatula!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
(...At this rate, the second episode is 
going to...)

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ...... "Cooperation."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe wishes to offer "assistance." 
...In order to eliminate the "debris."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Oh... Universe-san! Are you saying you 
will join our sweet <italics>orchestra</italics>!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Mmh... Indeed, I foresee a terrible omen 
in the show's future... Let's add our 
lucky power to clear away the dark clouds!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? Me too?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, thank you so, soooo much!! 
In that case...!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
And so! Starting today, these three will 
also appear as program assistants-maasu! 
Please treat us well-deesu!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: ...WHAAAT!?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
H-Hold on a second. 
We're... appearing on the show too?

text_block_list.name: Student Organizer
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... this is hard for me to ask, but 
please, I beg of you too... 
If things stay like this, it's going to be 
a total disaster...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...You've got to be kidding me...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Now then! Sweet <italics>orchestra</italics>, let us play our 
ensemble! 
Uno, due, tre—

text_block_list.name: All Five
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah!" "<italics>Grandioso</italics>!" "Great Blessing!" 
"'AMRT.'" "Y-Yay..."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Zero coordination...
